title: Canon EOS R6 Mark III All-Rounder Full-Frame
purpose: A top-of-the-class all-rounder for shooters who want to do anything and everything, pairing 32.5MP resolution with excellent autofocus and 7K 60p video capture.

sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 35mm full-frame CMOS with next-gen Dual Pixel AF (32.5MP)
sensor_and_optics.lens: Canon RF 24-70mm F2.8L IS USM (15/21 elements, 9 circular blades)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 15.0 stops dynamic range with 14-bit RAW and 7K 60p oversampled capture
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Focal-plane electronic/mechanical shutter with 1/250s flash sync and next-gen burst tracking

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Dynamic balanced ambient and studio strobe illumination, 1/250s sync, ISO 100
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Sculpted key light 45 degrees off-axis with soft rim edge separation, controlled negative fill maintaining crisp contrast modeling, true highlight retention

surface_rendering: Nuanced epidermal skin texture with resolved micro-pores, natural complexion tones, and signature Canon warm skin color science
Tactile material micro-relief: fabric thread weave, leather grain, brushed metal reflections, and smooth highlight roll-off
Exceptional edge acuity from L-series optics without digital edge halos or oversharpening artifacts
Editorial cleanliness with natural microcontrast, zero synthetic denoise smearing or plastic smoothing
depth_and_optics: Tack-sharp autofocus tracking locked on subject near eye, absolute zero motion blur on decisive action
Creamy, progressive out-of-focus transition characteristic of premium RF glass at f/2.8-f/4
Distortion-free rectilinear projection with faithful optical perspective

execution_directive: Enforce top-of-the-class 32.5MP full-frame raw capture with next-gen eye-tracking autofocus lock, authentic Canon skin tones, and balanced tonal gradations.
